description: This is a PHP source file defining the class 'Transaction' in the namespace 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Account'. The class manages customer transaction operations such as adding, deleting, and retrieving transactions within an OpenCart project.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: A model class to handle customer transactions, including adding, deleting, and retrieving transaction data from the database.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Adds a customer transaction record to the database with customer ID, order ID, description, and amount.

methods.name: deleteTransaction
methods.description: Deletes a transaction record for a specific customer ID and optional order ID.

methods.name: deleteTransactionByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes all transactions associated with a specific order ID where the amount is less than zero.

methods.name: getTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of transactions for a specified customer, with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getTotalTransactions
methods.description: Returns the total count of transactions for a specific customer.

methods.name: getTotalTransactionsByOrderId
methods.description: Returns the count of transactions associated with a specific order ID.

methods.name: getTransactionTotal
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total sum of transaction amounts for a specific customer.
